check_catalog_age_days.description: Days since the check catalog / benchmarks were last reviewed against upstream (CIS, ATT&CK, Sigma/Falco)

collector_coverage_gaps.description: Assets in scope that a collector could not cover (platform health, inner loop)

critical_config_findings.description: Open critical findings that are not vulnerabilities (configuration, exposure, identity, secrets, agents)

critical_open_findings.description: Open findings of severity critical (any layer)

kev_affecting_assets.description: Open findings whose CVE is in CISA KEV (known exploited)

kev_or_critical_exposed.description: Vulnerability findings prioritized critical (KEV or CRITICAL, weighted by exposure and EPSS)

oldest_fixable_critical_cve_days.description: Days since publication of the oldest CRITICAL CVE that has a fix, in running images / repos

public_repos_without_protection.description: Public repositories whose default branch has no protection / ruleset

secrets_older_than_90d.description: Secrets (files, cluster Secrets, CI secrets) not changed for more than 90 days

ssh_password_auth_hosts.description: Hosts whose SSH server accepts passwords

time_to_know_hours.description: Longest time-to-know (last 30 days) for KEV / critical / high detections on already-covered assets - advisory or KEV publication (date granularity: an upper bound) to the first finding; images, repos, hosts and firmware

unauth_network_services.description: Sensitive services that answer without authentication from the external vantage point

vuln_alertable.description: Vulnerabilities that affect our assets AND (are in CISA KEV OR are critical on an exposed asset) - the only vulnerability class that pages
